item.title: Soma 1.0 (748)
item.description:
Soma 1.0 (748)

  • Performance and feature improvements to People Hierarchy
  • Added Document Briefcase - keep track of those key documents
  • Smart Lists for People based on team
  • Fine tuning Cortex - not sure it did any good tbh
  • Auto search on any page - just type and search starts
  • Added task creation date label
  • iCloud Sync log for troubleshooting
  • plus quite a few other minor fixes.

Soma is still in beta testing. Keep backups on (Settings › Backups).
